# Data Security and Privacy FAQs

Justin Graves·April 21, 2025 at 5:35 PM

## Overview

This article answers common questions about how BombBomb handles your data, secures your videos, and supports your privacy rights.

**Who this applies to:** All Users

**Plan requirement:** Core, Core + Copilot, Enterprise

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How does BombBomb protect my data?** BombBomb uses industry-standard security practices to protect your content and personal information, including encryption of all data at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+), applied to databases, backups, and file storage. Only authorized personnel can access user data, and access is controlled through role-based permissions. BombBomb's infrastructure is SOC 2 Type II certified.

**Does BombBomb share or sell my personal information?** BombBomb may share personal information in certain circumstances, including with trusted third-party service providers who perform services on BombBomb's behalf, and with third-party providers for advertising-related purposes. BombBomb does not sell the personal information of users under 16 years of age. For a complete and current description of how BombBomb shares personal information, review the [BombBomb Privacy Policy](https://bombbomb.com/privacy/).

**Where is my data stored?** All user data and video content are stored on servers located in the United States, in secure, SOC 2 Type II-compliant data centers operated by trusted cloud providers.

**Can I delete my videos?** Yes. You can delete any video from your Workspace at any time. Once deleted, the video is permanently removed and cannot be recovered.

**Can I request that all of my data be deleted?** Yes. To request deletion of all data associated with your account, email the BombBomb Compliance Team at [forgetme@bombbomb.com](mailto:forgetme@bombbomb.com). BombBomb will complete the deletion within 30 days of confirmation. Note that deleted data may persist in backup copies for a short period before permanent removal. For more information, see the [BombBomb Privacy Policy](https://bombbomb.com/privacy/).

**Is BombBomb compliant with data protection regulations?** Yes. BombBomb adheres to applicable data privacy laws and frameworks, including GDPR, CCPA, the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, and CAN-SPAM. For full details on BombBomb's compliance commitments and your rights as a user, see the [BombBomb Privacy Policy](https://bombbomb.com/privacy/).

**How do I report a security concern or suspected account compromise?** If you believe your BombBomb account has been compromised, or if you have concerns about data handling or security, submit a report using the [BombBomb Abuse Prevention and Reporting Form](https://bombbomb.com/reporting/).
